chapter: Closing: recent career, family and travel
title: Basin Street East colleagues and his repertoire
summary: He met Al Hirt, Trini Lopez and others, and his wide repertoire helps on single jobs.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well, you ought to play down there.
I've never been there. I've been all over the world, and I've never been there, so...
Well, they have some places where pianists play. It would suit you very well.
Well, I imagine so. I mean...

See, when I played at Basin Street East I met Al Hirt, ...(?)..., Trini Lopez, Buddy Greco, Maynard Ferguson. I was at Basin Street East for several years, you know, as the house pianist there. And I understand he's got a place on the New Orleans...Hirt has...

If I can bring his memory back to the Basin Street East, perhaps we can have a conversation. I played with Charlie a lot, the late Charlie Shavers, and he and Charlie Shavers were very great friends, I understand.
One thing we haven't talked about... You have a really extensive repertoire, haven't you.
More or less, yeah. Because you play in so many different places and you have to play requests, so I take it you know all the standards...
Yes. I've been around the world. And it's become effective, especially when I play the single jobs,
you know... My repertoire comes in very handy.
